title: Edit-time standards retrieval recalls the standards the edit needs
body:
Evidence: #1380 (49fa8d1) retrieval report: edit moment recalls 3 of 12 reachable labels and 0.09 of all 33 labels, against task-start 17/17 and query 22/22. Edit time is when a standard would prevent a defect, so the brain misses most of its value there.
Outcome: node evals/retrieval/run.ts prints edit-moment recall at least 0.75 of reachable labels and names why each unreachable label is unreachable at edit time.
Proof: node evals/retrieval/run.ts: edit recall >= 0.75 reachable
Files: evals/retrieval/run.ts, src/hook/
